what: For 01271 (compile_error_is_an_error_at_the_call): hir-ty-borrowck must not borrow-check a body tainted by a failed macro expansion, as rustc (ExprKind::Err taints, mir_borrowck skips). Patch: add to `enum NotChecked` `/// A macro call in it failed to expand, an error reported at the call: rustc lowers it to `ExprKind::Err`, which taints the body.\n    ExpansionErrors,`; in check_def after the `has_lowering_errors` check: `if hir_ty_mir::mir::has_failed_expansion(db, owner) { result.not_checked = Some(NotChecked::ExpansionErrors); return result; }`; the same in borrowck_anon_const before check_owner (owner = InferBodyId::AnonConstId(konst)). Fix any exhaustive match on NotChecked (gate.rs, blaze-diagnostics). hir_ty_mir::mir::has_failed_expansion is in the tree (uncompiled); lowering now gives MirLowerError::HasErrors for such a body.

history.note: applied by the borrowck owner: NotChecked::ExpansionErrors, set in check_def after has_lowering_errors and in borrowck_anon_const before check_owner, from hir_ty_mir::mir::has_failed_expansion. Ready for the next round
